migrations.description: Leads table for the /about contact form (read by Manage → Leads)

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS leads (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT, email TEXT NOT NULL, company TEXT, message TEXT, source TEXT, created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS leads_created_at_idx ON leads (created_at)

verify.sql: SELECT 1 AS missing WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'leads')
